# Pixel2Tech

> Branding, web design, video and automation studio in Lahore, Pakistan. Pixel2Tech is a creative and web studio: we design brands, build websites and apps, produce video and automate busywork for clients worldwide.

Key facts:

- Founded in 2023, based in Lahore, Pakistan, working with clients worldwide.
- Founders: Usama Farooq (CEO & Founder) and Asad Farooq (Co-Founder & Creative Director).
- Services: Branding & Design, Website Development, WordPress & Shopify, Custom Platforms & Apps, Automation & CRM, AI Solutions, SEO & Search Growth, Social Media & Email, Video Editing & Ads.
- Contact: sales@pixel2tech.com, +92 317 7475233 (phone and WhatsApp).

## Pages

- [Home](https://pixel2tech.com/): What the studio does, selected work, client feedback and how a project runs.

- [Portfolio](https://pixel2tech.com/portfolio): Branding, web, social media and video work.

- [Contact](https://pixel2tech.com/contact): Email, WhatsApp, working hours, location and the project brief form.

## Services

Each page covers deliverables, who the service is for, how a project runs, how pricing works (a fixed written quote after a free scoping call; no public price list), related case studies and common questions.

- [Branding & Design](https://pixel2tech.com/services/branding-and-design): Logo, color palette, typography, brand guidelines, templates and UI design for startups and small businesses.
- [Website Development](https://pixel2tech.com/services/website-development): Mobile-ready websites built in React, Next.js or custom code, from landing pages to full business sites.
- [WordPress & Shopify](https://pixel2tech.com/services/wordpress-and-shopify): Shopify stores and WordPress sites: theme customization, product pages, apps, payments, speed fixes and migrations.
- [Custom Platforms & Apps](https://pixel2tech.com/services/custom-platforms-and-apps): Custom web apps, SaaS products, client portals, dashboards and mobile apps, starting from an MVP.
- [Automation & CRM](https://pixel2tech.com/services/automation-and-crm): Workflow automation in n8n, Make or Zapier, CRM setup, lead routing and integrations.
- [AI Solutions](https://pixel2tech.com/services/ai-solutions): AI chatbots, voice agents and RAG document search that answer from a business's own content.
- [SEO & Search Growth](https://pixel2tech.com/services/seo-and-search-growth): Technical SEO audits, on-page fixes, keyword strategy, local SEO and store SEO.
- [Social Media & Email](https://pixel2tech.com/services/social-media-and-email): Social content, Meta ad creative, email flows and newsletters.
- [Video Editing & Ads](https://pixel2tech.com/services/video-editing-and-ads): Reels, YouTube edits, brand videos and paid video ad creative, cut for each platform.
